title:
Code analysis metric to verify references to Types, fields, methods, and topics in
[.c3typ](FileExt#TYPE) and [.c3doc.md](FileExt#DOC) files.

Within the context of this metric, "mark**down**" refers to raw {@link Markdown} content and
"mark**up**" refers to {@link DocumentationMarkup} content parsed by {@link DocumentationParser}.
name: BaseCodeAnalysis.Metric.BrokenDocumentationLinks
